chunks: From him, from Ismail ibn Mansur, from Al-Mufazzal, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Any Muslim who meets a Muslim and gladdens him, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will gladden him.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for making a Muslim happy?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this concise hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the profound spiritual reciprocity of social kindness, where pleasing a fellow Muslim becomes a direct cause for divine pleasure. It underscores the Shia emphasis on maintaining strong communal bonds (Silat al-Ard) as a means of attaining closeness to Allah, transforming simple social interactions into acts of worship.
